name: get_lahze_capabilities
description: Structured capabilities, limits, scopes, languages and available tools. Short and cacheable.

name: get_connection_status
description: Check whether this agent is connected to a Lahze account.

name: get_authorization_url
description: Return the OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256) authorization URL for a registered client.

name: disconnect_lahze
description: Revoke this agent’s access tokens for the connected Lahze account.

name: get_my_profile
description: Get the connected Lahze profile (never exposes passwords or private secrets).

name: get_memory_categories
description: List active memory categories from Lahze. Use one of these ids in create_memory_draft.

name: search_places
description: Search verified places in the Lahze catalog. Never invent coordinates. Pass query/city, or user coordinates as lat+lng.

name: create_memory_draft
description: Create a memory draft. Only Persian (Farsi) memories are accepted. Do not create or publish memories in English or any other language. Ask the user for the real place/date; never invent them. Returns a draft_id that must be confirmed by the user before publish_memory.

name: publish_memory
description: Publish a draft only after the user explicitly confirms. Only Persian (Farsi) memories are accepted. Do not create or publish memories in English or any other language. Rejects other users’ drafts, expired drafts and duplicates. Suspicious memories are saved for review, not deleted.

name: get_my_memories
description: List the connected account’s memories, newest first (paginated, max 20).

name: get_memory_details
description: Get details of one memory owned by the connected account. Cross-account access is rejected.

name: get_my_drafts
description: List this agent’s memory drafts for the connected account (status, expiry, pending confirmations). Use it to resume an unfinished memory.

name: search_public_memories
description: Full-text search over PUBLIC published memories (Persian). No account needed. Great for exploring Lahze before writing.

name: get_media_upload_requirements
description: Media limits and the supported way to attach photos (no parallel upload from MCP).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_authorization_url" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256) authorization URL for a registered client.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_profile" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get the connected Lahze profile (never exposes passwords or private secrets).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_authorization_url · Private data: disconnect_lahze, get_my_profile · Public sink: create_memory_draft, publish_memory, get_media_upload_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_authorization_url · Private data: disconnect_lahze, get_my_profile · Public sink: create_memory_draft, publish_memory, get_media_upload_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
